subject: Consolidating surge slots and split-run demo for renewal QBR
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clearsight.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating surge slots and split-run demo for renewal QBR

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Based on our conversation I sketched a compact plan that should hit your exec + technical stakeholders while keeping the live demo crisp. Proposal: run two phased "waves" rather than one long session so teams in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC get meaningful overlap windows.

• Wave A: Oct 28, 09:00–10:30 PT — pre-brief (10), live demo (60), exec Q&A (20)
• Wave B: Oct 29, 06:00–07:30 PT — technical deep dive for APAC overlap and hands-on Q&A

Rationale: reduces single-session fatigue and lets us tailor the walkthrough per stakeholder group. I attached a draft agenda (QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf).

Can you confirm: primary exec(s) who must be present, any hard blackout windows, and whether you want the hands-on walkthrough to include a small sandbox for your engineers? If we get a quick thumbs up I’ll convert this to two calendar invites and loop in Karthik as technical co-host.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0123

Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf

From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clearsight.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya@clearsight.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating surge slots and split-run demo for renewal QBR

On Tue, Oct 20, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time today. Based on our conversation I sketched a compact plan...

Marissa —

Appreciate the plan. A few constraints from our side: our CTO has a hard blackout on Oct 28 after 11:00 PT, and our VP of Product is traveling Oct 28–29. Would you be able to shift to Oct 29 morning and/or Oct 30 morning instead? We’d prefer two 60-minute sessions (shorter, sharper) rather than the longer 90/120 blocks.

I attached the stakeholder matrix so you can see who needs which part of the agenda (Clearsight_stakeholder_matrix.xlsx). Also: procurement is aiming to close the purchase order by 11/05, so a DocuSign-ready package after the demo would be ideal.

One ask — can Karthik handle the hands-on walkthrough on the second session while you run the exec Q&A? That split would work well for us.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Director, IT & Analytics, Clearsight Analytics
alex.mercer@clearsight.com

Attachment: Clearsight_stakeholder_matrix.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-20T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating surge slots and split-run demo for renewal QBR

Alex —

Perfect — thanks for the matrix, that clarifies the must-have attendees. Revised (compact) proposal below:

• Session 1 (exec + product): Oct 29, 09:00–10:00 PT — 20m pre-brief / 30m demo highlights / 10m exec Q&A
• Session 2 (tech deep-dive): Oct 30, 08:30–09:30 PT — 10m setup / 40m hands-on walkthrough / 10m open issues

Karthik is good to co-host the tech session; I’ll handle the exec session. Neha will manage recording permissions and run the post-demo clips we discussed. I attached an updated agenda (QBR_Agenda_v4.pdf) and added an internal run-of-show.

If that looks good I’ll:
• Send two calendar invites with dial-in + recording enabled
• Share a DocuSign envelope once invites are accepted (DocuSign link included below)

DocuSign (internal ref): https://docusign.net/sign/clearsight-renewal-8342

Can you confirm Priya + the CTO as attendees for Session 1?

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v4.pdf

Marissa —

Two small ops asks from my side before you send invites:
1) Please enable auto-record and mark the recording to be split into two clips (exec highlights + tech walkthrough) so we can send a short exec summary if someone drops off.
2) Add Stephanie Nguyen as the backup host in the second session (she can jump in if Karthik gets pulled into a firefight).

I’ll also prepare a one-page follow-up playbook we can hand to Clearsight immediately after Session 2.

Marissa —

Confirmed. We’ll do Session 1 on Oct 29 09:00–10:00 PT and Session 2 on Oct 30 08:30–09:30 PT as you proposed. Priya and our CTO will attend Session 1; procurement attached a short note on PO timing (Clearsight_procurement_note.pdf).
